title: Generic BOSH HTTP exchange via ooRexx API Client
summary: A separate BOSH/API Client adapter maps the generic BoshHttpExchangeProvider seam onto api.client/0.4 without adding HTTP, TLS, SocketProvider or XTP implementation knowledge to BOSH.
invariants: BOSH continues to own only XEP-0124 logical-stream/session semantics.
API Client owns HTTP framing, redirect policy, TLS identity verification, route/session selection and admission.
The adapter performs shape conversion only and grants neither layer additional semantic authority.
Cleartext HTTP is denied by adapter default and requires explicit deployment policy to enable.
API Client v0.4.1 currently documents native socket ownership as RxSock, so this adapter is not evidence for HTTPS-over-XTP.
HTTPS-over-XTP requires a lower API Client or shared-selector transport backend; BOSH and the adapter must not select XTP directly.

provenance.claim: Implements BoshHttpExchangeProvider by constructing ApiRequest and mapping ApiResponse back to BoshHttpResponse.
API Client v0.4.1 owns HTTP/HTTPS and documents native socket ownership as RxSock.

open: Run deterministic adapter test under ooRexx 5.3.0 with exact BOSH and API Client roots.
Qualify live HTTPS BOSH exchange through API Client.
Add a provider/selector-capable API Client transport backend before making any HTTPS-over-XTP claim.
